name: NationStates
description: NationStates is a long-running online nation simulation game where players create and govern a custom country according to their political ideals. Players respond to daily issues, manage economy and rights, and engage in international politics within a persistent global community.
reputation: One of the largest and most enduring online political simulation communities, with millions of player-created nations.
notes: Combines simulation with community-driven role-play; some automated elements for ongoing world state.
